import pytest
import io
from rich.console import Console
from rich.prompt import Confirm

def test_confirm_invalid_choice_markup_disabled() -> None:
    console = Console(markup=False, file=io.StringIO())
    with pytest.raises(Exception) as excinfo:
        Confirm.ask("Continue", console=console, choices=["y", "n"])
    assert str(excinfo.value) == "[prompt.invalid]Please enter Y or N"
